source.title: Video lighting guide
source.creator: @responsiveowl1667
source.rights: Third-party guide; source media and illustrations not licensed for repository redistribution

authority.A: source moving image and unaltered original audio
authority.B: reference for light and color ONLY; never as a start frame
authority.priority: A/C for subject, scene, performance, lens and temporal continuity; B lighting only

catalog.name: High-key
catalog.lighting_setup: Large frontal diffusion plus strong fill; bright environment; low contrast
catalog.qc_trap: Flatness; face highlights clipping

catalog.name: Low-key
catalog.lighting_setup: Isolated soft key, negative fill and dark background
catalog.qc_trap: Crushed skin/wardrobe information

catalog.name: Rembrandt
catalog.lighting_setup: Raised key about 45 degrees; far-cheek triangle; restrained fill
catalog.dramatic_use: Split moral perspective in readable portrait
catalog.qc_trap: Triangle fails to track face turn

catalog.name: Butterfly (Paramount)
catalog.lighting_setup: Elevated frontal key; compact nose shadow; soft facial falloff
catalog.qc_trap: Unapproved beautification of texture

catalog.name: Split
catalog.lighting_setup: Hard 90-degree side key; near-half facial shadow
catalog.dramatic_use: Visible internal contrast or contested allegiance
catalog.qc_trap: Rotating face breaks shadow geometry

catalog.name: Loop
catalog.lighting_setup: Soft slightly off-axis elevated key; short nose-to-cheek shadow
catalog.qc_trap: Nose shadow or key direction drifts

catalog.name: Broad
catalog.lighting_setup: Key toward the side of the face nearest the camera
catalog.qc_trap: Face turn changes near/far direction

catalog.name: Short
catalog.lighting_setup: Key the far cheek; camera-facing cheek darker
catalog.qc_trap: Incorrect face orientation or race/skin exposure

catalog.name: Chiaroscuro
catalog.lighting_setup: One strong directed beam; deep background falloff
catalog.qc_trap: Black crush and implausible environment separation

catalog.name: Silhouette
catalog.lighting_setup: Strong background exposure, minimal frontal fill
catalog.qc_trap: Unapproved loss of required identity legibility

catalog.name: Rim / backlight
catalog.lighting_setup: Source behind head and shoulders, subtle frontal base
catalog.qc_trap: Rim detaches from hair/hat outline

catalog.name: Hard light
catalog.lighting_setup: Compact direct unfiltered source; crisp shadows
catalog.qc_trap: Shadow alignment and impossible occlusion

catalog.name: Soft light
catalog.lighting_setup: Large diffused source with broad falloff
catalog.qc_trap: Waxy diffusion or erased pore detail

catalog.name: Bounce
catalog.lighting_setup: Off-axis reflected warm light; no new visible bounce prop
catalog.qc_trap: Invisible fill source inconsistent with scene

catalog.name: Top light
catalog.lighting_setup: Overhead source; eyes and jaw deepen into shade
catalog.qc_trap: Eye detail crushed; glasses highlights wrong

catalog.name: Under lighting
catalog.lighting_setup: Low source below face; shadows travel upward
catalog.qc_trap: Artificial up-shadow tracking

catalog.name: Golden hour
catalog.lighting_setup: Low warm side/back sun and long natural shadows
catalog.qc_trap: Sun angle contradicts location/background

catalog.name: Blue hour
catalog.lighting_setup: Cool, diffuse dusk ambient with subdued contrast
catalog.qc_trap: Daylight sky/window contradiction

catalog.name: Day-for-night
catalog.lighting_setup: Reduce daylight exposure with cool night contrast and reworked backgrounds
catalog.qc_trap: Sun shadows/sky expose false night

catalog.name: Moonlight
catalog.lighting_setup: Low-level cool silver ambient/key with restrained shadows
catalog.qc_trap: Plastic blue grading or unmotivated moon angle

catalog.name: Window light
catalog.lighting_setup: Large side source outside frame with natural interior falloff
catalog.qc_trap: Window orientation and reflections mismatch

catalog.name: Practical
catalog.lighting_setup: Warm pools motivated by existing lamps/fixtures
catalog.dramatic_use: Domestic space, memory texture and ordinary rituals
catalog.qc_trap: Added lamp or illumination from absent fixture

catalog.name: Firelight / candlelight
catalog.lighting_setup: Warm low-angle fluctuating source; dark surroundings
catalog.dramatic_use: Intimate low-light conversation or folk atmosphere
catalog.qc_trap: Unauthorized flames or erratic fake flicker

catalog.name: Venetian blinds
catalog.lighting_setup: Parallel slatted shadow pattern from a motivated window
catalog.qc_trap: Moving stripes detach from geometry

catalog.name: Dappled / gobo
catalog.lighting_setup: Fragmented occluded sunlight or chosen patterned gobo
catalog.dramatic_use: Exteriors, memory of landscape, unstable calm
catalog.qc_trap: Light pattern ignores subject depth/movement

catalog.name: Volumetric (god rays)
catalog.lighting_setup: Visible beams through justified haze from an off-screen source
catalog.qc_trap: Decorative beams without credible particles/source

catalog.name: Overcast / flat
catalog.lighting_setup: Broad grey ambient sky; low shadow direction
catalog.qc_trap: Flattened depth, clipped clouds, false wetness

catalog.name: Neon
catalog.lighting_setup: Motivated saturated colored off-screen spill; mixed practical contrast
catalog.qc_trap: Unauthorized signs/neon fixtures or skin hue drift

catalog.name: Teal & orange
catalog.lighting_setup: Warm controlled facial key against cool teal environment
catalog.qc_trap: Canned blockbuster grade and unnatural skin

catalog.name: Monochrome red
catalog.lighting_setup: Deep red motivated wash with black shadow separation
catalog.qc_trap: Lost facial detail and red clipping

catalog.name: Screen glow
catalog.lighting_setup: Cool blue-white local soft source from established/off-screen screen
catalog.qc_trap: Added device or untracked flicker

catalog.name: Passing light
catalog.lighting_setup: Directional beams sweeping across existing geometry in real time
catalog.dramatic_use: Changed attention or movement outside frame
catalog.qc_trap: Unmotivated car/fixture and time-incoherent shadows

catalog.name: Strobe / flicker
catalog.lighting_setup: Controlled intermittent illumination; subject action unchanged
catalog.dramatic_use: Rare stress or experimental music punctuation
catalog.qc_trap: Photosensitivity; rapid flashes; apparent jump cuts

catalog.name: Theatrical spotlight
catalog.lighting_setup: Hard focused pool with dark preserved surroundings
catalog.qc_trap: New stage/backdrop or spot stops tracking subject
